create_nav_dataset: create a NavDataset instance with config, habitat environment, and device for PACMAN navigation training
convert_flat_to_hierarchical_actions: convert flat navigation actions into hierarchical planner and controller actions with indices
extract_image_features: extract CNN image features from a numpy array or torch tensor using the pretrained MultitaskCNN encoder
preprocess_navigation_actions: preprocess episode actions by remapping action codes and padding to max action length for batch processing
map_dataset_sample: map a webdataset sample to preprocessed features including planner actions, controller actions, and image features
